otis_talk.speaker: otis
otis_talk.text:
Red! There you are. Welcome to the
test room, friend.

otis_talk.speaker: otis
otis_talk.text:
Sorry about the mat. It says WELCOME,
but it's upside down. Safer that way.

otis_talk.speaker: otis
otis_talk.text:
Mm-hm. That's the 'what is all this?'
face. Fair question.

otis_talk.speaker: otis
otis_talk.text:
I can give you the grand tour. Or you
can poke things and see what happens.

otis_talk_again.speaker: otis
otis_talk_again.text:
Back already? Good. I was just counting
the room. Everyone's here. I like that.

otis_talk_again.speaker: otis
otis_talk_again.text:
Sorry, I lost count at the crates.
They all look like crates.

otis_talk_again.speaker: otis
otis_talk_again.text:
Aw. That one needs no translating.
Sorry, I got a little misty. Dust.

otis_poke.speaker: otis
otis_poke.text: Ha! Poking is the oldest science there is.

otis_poke.speaker: otis
otis_poke.text: Sorry in advance if something pokes back.

otis_poke.speaker: otis
otis_poke.text:
That's 'thanks, Otis' and 'don't wait up.'
Both received. Go on, then.

long_briefing.speaker: otis
long_briefing.text:
Right! The grand tour. Hold on to your
hat. I'm holding on to mine.

long_briefing.speaker: mox
long_briefing.text:
DIBS on narrating! This is a TEST ROOM.
For testing! Like me!

long_briefing.speaker: otis
long_briefing.text: Mox. Shh. How did you get in here?

long_briefing.speaker: otis
long_briefing.text:
Sorry, friend, I'll make it quick. Talk to
folks. Examine things. Grab what glints.

long_briefing.speaker: mox
long_briefing.text:
She's saying 'Mox is a genius.' I can
tell. It's all in the ears.

long_briefing.speaker: otis
long_briefing.text:
She's saying there's a shiny crate up on
that platform. Go on. Up you go.

mox_talk.speaker: mox
mox_talk.text:
Red! Behold! My Automatic Door-Opener-
Closer-Opener! It's forty percent finished!

mox_talk.speaker: mox
mox_talk.text:
And the forty percent that works is
INCREDIBLE. Tuesday, stay off the button.

mox_talk.speaker: mox
mox_talk.text:
TUESDAY! NOT THE BUTTON! ...Oh no. It's
smoking. IT'S SMOKING! AAAAAAAAH!

mox_talk.speaker: mox
mox_talk.text:
...one... two... three... four. Okay.
I'm fine. Smoke is a feature.

mox_talk.speaker: mox
mox_talk.text:
I know that look! 'Mox, I would wrestle a
comet for your machine.' Aw! Please don't.
It's not rated for comets.

mox_talk.speaker: mox
mox_talk.text:
Modest! She's being modest! So, should I
press the button or not press the button?

mox_talk_again.speaker: mox
mox_talk_again.text: Shh! I'm adding a second button.

mox_talk_again.speaker: mox
mox_talk_again.text: It's a panic button. For the first button.

mox_talk_again.speaker: mox
mox_talk_again.text:
I know! 'Mox, that is the safest thing
anyone has ever built.' Thanks! I'm touched.
Don't touch the first button.

mox_press.speaker: mox
mox_press.text:
CONFETTI! Ration-wrapper confetti! That
was supposed to be a rocket!

mox_press.speaker: mox
mox_press.text: But confetti is... part of the forty percent.

mox_press.speaker: mox
mox_press.text: She loves it! I knew she would. Obviously.

mox_nopress.speaker: mox
mox_nopress.text: Smart. Super smart. I would have pressed it.

mox_nopress.speaker: mox
mox_nopress.text:
Don't worry, it's only a little bit
explosive. ...A medium little bit.

mox_nopress.speaker: mox
mox_nopress.text:
Fine! We'll just stand here and admire
the smoke. It's very good smoke.

zero_talk.speaker: zero_old
zero_talk.text:
Watch Zero, SOUND OFF! *DING-DING!*
That's me. Fewer answer every year.
I answer double.

zero_talk.speaker: zero_old
zero_talk.text: You, kid! Stand still when I'm talking!

zero_talk.speaker: zero_old
zero_talk.text:
The Signals Corps wrote me up for noise.
In a room built for testing noise! *DING!*

zero_talk.speaker: zero_old
zero_talk.text:
I've out-shouted a sergeant. Twice.
Before breakfast. *DING!*

zero_talk.speaker: zero_old
zero_talk.text:
You've got the look of someone who runs
toward trouble. Good. Take this.

zero_talk.speaker: zero_old
zero_talk.text:
Canned Coffee. Drink it before something
needs yelling at. *DING!*

zero_talk.speaker: zero_old
zero_talk.text:
Don't thank me! Gratitude is noisy!
*DING!* ...You're welcome.

zero_talk.speaker: zero_old
zero_talk.text:
And keep that lamp of yours lit. The old
customs don't keep themselves.

zero_talk_again.speaker: zero_old
zero_talk_again.text:
Still here? Good. Somebody has to hear
me complain. *DING!*

zero_talk_again.speaker: zero_old
zero_talk_again.text:
No, there's no more coffee. I am not a
vending machine! *DING-DING!*

zero_talk_again.speaker: zero_old
zero_talk_again.text:
Don't give me that look. ...Fine. Sit.
Listen to the bell. It's soothing.

zero_talk_again.speaker: zero_old
zero_talk_again.text:
That's the sound of a mast nobody has
jammed. Sweetest noise there is. *ding*

examine_pillar.speaker: narrator
examine_pillar.text:
A stone pillar. It holds up nothing in
particular. Someone stenciled a ring-and-bar
on it anyway.

examine_pillar.speaker: narrator
examine_pillar.text:
Scratched in at Mox height:
MOX WUZ HERE.

examine_lamp.speaker: narrator
examine_lamp.text:
A brass lamp on a stand. Warm to the touch,
slightly crooked, and probably unpermitted.

examine_lamp.speaker: narrator
examine_lamp.text:
Red taps the glass twice before she
notices. Habit.

examine_crate.speaker: narrator
examine_crate.text:
A plain crate, stenciled:
CONTENTS: NOTHING (TESTED).

examine_crate.speaker: narrator
examine_crate.text:
You knock. Nobody knocks back. Mox is not
in this one. Probably.

examine_prize_crate.speaker: narrator
examine_prize_crate.text:
A shiny crate on the raised platform.
A tiny flag on top reads WINNER.

examine_prize_crate.speaker: narrator
examine_prize_crate.text:
You jumped up here, so you win. Inside:
a Ration Bar. It tastes like the wrapper.

examine_prize_crate_again.speaker: narrator
examine_prize_crate_again.text:
The prize crate is empty. A note inside:
THANKS FOR PLAYING.

examine_sign.speaker: sign
examine_sign.text:
TEST ROOM
PLEASE DO NOT TEST THE TEST ROOM

examine_sign.speaker: sign
examine_sign.text:
Management has noted that you are
currently testing this sign. In triplicate.

examine_sign.speaker: sign
examine_sign.text:
Management thanks you for your testing.
Please stop.

examine_window.speaker: narrator
examine_window.text:
A window, painted onto the back wall. The
painted stars are doing their best.

examine_window.speaker: narrator
examine_window.text:
In the corner: a tiny painted lamp in a
tiny painted window. Red gives it a thumbs-up.
